title: Verification registry frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of knowledge/verifications.md — the registry of verifications available in this repo. A verification is anything that checks an experiment: a deterministic script, an AI-review checker, or observing a metric and drawing conclusions. Verifications both gate the loop and feed analysis (a revealed problem can seed a follow-up experiment).

verifies.description: What property of an experiment this verification checks, and what its failure suggests (fix vs follow-up experiment).

phase.description: Pipeline phase (0-4) where it runs, if phase-bound.

gating.description: gate = a failure blocks the loop; advisory = feeds analysis and anomaly triggers; analysis-only = interpreted by humans/AI during analysis.

params.description: Checker parameters: band bounds, spike factor, patience, tolerance, assertion pattern.

metric.description: For metric-observation entries: the observed metric.

kind.description: primary = measures experiment quality (headline); proxy = correlates with primary, localizes what to improve; diagnostic = training health.

definition.description: What the metric computes, precisely enough to reimplement.

logged_by.description: Where in the code / which component emits it.

implemented_by.description: The change that introduced or last modified this verification.

references.description: Reference values with provenance, backfilled by running the repo's standard eval command on frozen reference checkpoint(s) — over all saved checkpoints for through-training metrics. Run records are never edited retroactively.

checkpoint.description: Which checkpoint(s) the value was measured on.

value.description: Number, array for vector metrics (e.g. per-position), or per-checkpoint series.

measured_at.description: Commit hash of the measuring code.
